transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for offering to help with the plant care. As you know, the owner will be away July 1 through July 14, and we have three plants to place: a jade plant, an orchid, and a Boston fern. Before I make final assignments, I need each of you to give me your formal care note covering your home conditions and any schedule constraints. Marco and Talia, could you both share your notes? And I'll note that I have a sunny south-facing sunroom available. Once I have everyone's notes recorded, I'll finalize the placements.

transcript.text: Hi Lena, happy to share my formal care note. Here's what I can offer: I have a humid bathroom with bright indirect light that would be suitable for the orchid. However, I do have a schedule constraint — I'll be away from July 6 through July 8 and won't be able to water anything during that window. I know the orchid's care card calls for a watering on July 6, so whoever takes the orchid would need coverage that day. I'm otherwise available throughout the rest of the July 1–14 period.
